title: feat(ridclk): ridge-slide clock N_label=12 N_filt=6
science: The band's only axioms-adjacent result and its most substantive PR. On the 12 lex-first perp-mask hosts it scores leftover-frame-positive f with rho3 read two ways: as unused edge LABELS (a clock) it fires 12/12; as a cost-1 readiness FILTER it fires only 6/12. It then PROVES the exact iff: the six hosts that die are precisely those whose unread center has exactly two unit coordinates -- the same predicate that defines rho3's ridge clause. So the clock/filter gap is not incidental: a readiness reading transcribes the hop-cost's own clause straight into the Admissibility firing census (nu-family prior: mu 12/12, rho 12/4, now rho3 12/6). Rebuilds the July-3 pair and N_G+=24, N_pair=48. 32/32 checks, none vacuous. Promotion candidate.
